entries.candidate: China Mobile (Ningxia Zhongwei) Data Center Xuanhe Campus — construction named in the 20 October 2026 Xuanhe market-supervision record (buildings not identified)
entries.reason: The Shapotou District Branch of the Zhongwei Market Supervision Administration (20 October 2026, local spt-xuanhe-scjg-1020.html) names the China Mobile project lead among the key data-centre projects under construction in Xuanhe, but names no building. The campus has separate planning permits for D01-D04 (published 20 March 2026), D05-D06 (21 July 2026), the operations-support building (9 June 2026) and D07-D10 (20 September 2026, the only Atlas project). Refreshing D07-D10 to under construction, or adding D01-D06 as under construction, would assign the statement to buildings it does not identify.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated primary record (government, operator or contractor) identifying the buildings under construction, completed or operating at the Xuanhe campus; then refresh D07-D10 if named, or add the named buildings as a project on curated:china-mobile-ningxia-zhongwei-data-center-xuanhe reusing the campus locator.
